thread:
Eli (AE): Heads-up — Keystone FinServ just escalated to their execs. CISO says they will pause POC stage-2 unless we provide: 1) BYO-KMS attestation + integration plan, 2) written egress IP commitment, 3) a latency SLA for p95/p99. They're asking for an exec-level decision on trial credits/pricing. Can we triage? :exclamation:

Ben (SE): Quick summary of current blocker — their infra team can't complete the mutual TLS handshake to our VPC endpoint. I repro'd from their network via a jump host; TLS handshake times out (SYN -> no response). Looks like SNAT/NGFW rewrite on their side.

Ben (SE): Repro steps I used:
```
curl -Iv --resolve inference.redwood.example:443:34.201.32.12 https://inference.redwood.example/health
# handshake stalls at "SSL handshake" from their subnet
```

Ben (SE): We also tested routing a short-lived Dedicated instance (eu-west-1) and their egress to our allowlisted IP worked from our side. So two things: they need to open/route to our static IPs, and we can offer a temp Dedicated pool to guarantee latency.

Priya (Security): We can provide SOC 2 Type II, recent pen-test summary, and our KMS integration docs. BYOK is supported (AWS KMS/HSM) — we need Legal to sign a limited-key custody clause in DPA for the customer. I'll prep the attestation template. @Claire can you start the security questionnaire? :memo:

Martin (Infra): For a latency SLA (p95 <= 200ms), safe approach is a short Dedicated trial: reserve 4x GPU nodes (dedicated pool) in their region for 30 days + prefix allowlist. Ballpark infra cost for that config ~ $12k/day raw; with credits we can negotiate. Also network peering (VPC peering or static egress IPs + NAT) will remove most handshake flakiness.

Jordan (Head of Sales): TL;DR: Offer a 30–60 day sandbox with dedicated capacity + BYOK onboarding support. Proposal: 50% credits for the trial if they sign a 12-month reserved commitment within 45 days of trial end. That should get the execs to greenlight. Need approval from revenue leadership for the credit cap (suggest $100k max).@Eli — we can fast-track legal for the DPA change if they accept the revenue commitment.

Claire (CS): I'll open the security questionnaire and ask for the CISO's specific tokens: which pages are blocking them? Also propose a joint CISO call early next week. I can own calendaring and pre-call doc pack.

deploy-bot: deployment 2418701300 created test-dedicated-pool-keystone-eu-west-1a (4x-gpu). Routing: eu-west-1a -> 34.201.32.12/32, 34.201.32.13/32.

Martin (Infra): Sample allowlist snippet they can paste into their firewall:
```
# Keystone FinServ allowlist
34.201.32.12/32
34.201.32.13/32
34.201.32.14/32
```

Eli (AE): Next steps I propose:
- @Claire: schedule CISO call (ASAP) and kickoff questionnaire.
- @Priya: share attestation + BYOK integration doc and flag any DPA changes.
- @Martin: confirm final cost for 30/60 day dedicated trial and estimate credit needed.
- @Jordan: decide credit cap and signoff path for revenue leadership.

Eli (AE): Ask to execs: do we have approval to offer up to $100k in trial credits + expedited BYOK/legal review to unblock? If not, what's the ceiling? We need a yes/no within 24h to prevent them pausing the POC. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
